scenario.summary: An adversary leverages deceptive authentication portals to harvest credentials and identifies unpatched vulnerabilities across the attack surface. The campaign progresses to cloud runtime execution and lateral movement across microsegmented workloads, culminating in ransomware encryption and automated incident notification.

meta.rationale: Start with public-facing users and servers. Focus on assets with recent high-severity vulnerability findings reported by Holm Security.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary has harvested credentials through a phishing portal and is now using them to access vulnerable assets while attempting to evade multi-factor authentication.

blind_spots.risk: A domain-level hit is a lead, but without path visibility, we cannot distinguish a visit from a successful harvest.

blind_spots.remediation: Enable SSL decryption for known risky categories on the forward proxy.

blind_spots.risk: Silverfort context is high-quality, but if the hunt lacks visibility into on-prem DCs, legacy protocol abuse remains a blind spot.
blind_spots.question: Whether the adversary used legacy protocols to bypass MFA.
blind_spots.remediation: Onboard domain controller logs into the identity surface via Silverfort connector.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, actor_user_name, url_hostname, url_path, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE LOWER(url_hostname) IN ('{{phishing_domains}}') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify hosts and users interacting with known credential harvesting domains to establish a lead.
config.expected_signal: Hostnames and users visiting suspicious domains. Silence means no recorded interaction with the indicators.

primitive_config.label: Traffic to phishing portals
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, actor_user_name, url_hostname, url_path, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE LOWER(url_hostname) IN ('{{phishing_domains}}') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Hostnames and users visiting suspicious domains. Silence means no recorded interaction with the indicators.

config.objective: Determine if the observed phishing interactions are credible threats needing deeper investigation.
config.description: Decide if the HTTP traffic warrants searching into vulnerabilities and authentication logs.
config.expected_signal: A verdict per host on whether the traffic matches credential-harvesting behavior.
config.success_criteria: A verdict of investigate for any confirmed portal hits.

config.question: the agent verdict is to investigate for at least one host
config.condition: the agent verdict is to investigate for at least one host
config.description: Route the hunt based on the quality of the initial lead to save resources.

config.content: SELECT v.device_uid, d.hostname, v.cve_uid, v.severity, v.title FROM hb_vulnerability_finding v JOIN hb_devices d ON v.device_uid = d.device_uid WHERE v.severity_id >= 4 AND (('{{target_hosts}}' = '') OR (instr(',' || '{{target_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || d.hostname || ',') > 0))
config.description: Correlate the phishing lead with host vulnerability using Holm Security data.
config.expected_signal: Critical or High findings on the target host. Silence means no severe vulnerabilities are present.

primitive_config.label: Affected asset vulnerability findings
primitive_config.content: SELECT v.device_uid, d.hostname, v.cve_uid, v.severity, v.title FROM hb_vulnerability_finding v JOIN hb_devices d ON v.device_uid = d.device_uid WHERE v.severity_id >= 4 AND (('{{target_hosts}}' = '') OR (instr(',' || '{{target_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || d.hostname || ',') > 0))
primitive_config.expected: Critical or High findings on the target host. Silence means no severe vulnerabilities are present.

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, auth_protocol, status_detail, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE (status_id = 2 OR (status_id = 1 AND (mfa = 'false' OR mfa IS NULL))) AND (('{{target_users}}' = '') OR (instr(',' || '{{target_users}}' || ',', ',' || actor_user_name || ',') > 0)) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY actor_user_name, auth_protocol, status_detail HAVING host_count <= 2
config.description: Identify rare login failures or successful logins without MFA to detect credential abuse.
config.expected_signal: Rare failure patterns or MFA bypasses for the user. Silence means the authentication pattern is fleet-wide noise.

primitive_config.label: Rare authentication anomalies
primitive_config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, auth_protocol, status_detail, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE (status_id = 2 OR (status_id = 1 AND (mfa = 'false' OR mfa IS NULL))) AND (('{{target_users}}' = '') OR (instr(',' || '{{target_users}}' || ',', ',' || actor_user_name || ',') > 0)) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY actor_user_name, auth_protocol, status_detail HAVING host_count <= 2
primitive_config.expected: Rare failure patterns or MFA bypasses for the user. Silence means the authentication pattern is fleet-wide noise.

config.objective: Determine if the harvested credentials target vulnerable assets with suspicious login patterns.

config.expected_signal: A malicious verdict citing rows from three surfaces.
config.success_criteria: A per-host verdict weighing vulnerabilities against the phishing hit.

config.question: the final triage verdict is malicious for at least one host or user
config.condition: the final triage verdict is malicious for at least one host or user
config.description: Trigger containment for malicious hits or manual review for suspicious ones.
Contain the breach once credential abuse on a vulnerable asset is confirmed.
config.instructions: Isolate the involved host and suspend the user identity in the primary provider.

config.description: Confirm agentic findings and perform detailed incident response.
config.instructions: Review correlated evidence: verify the phishing portal URL, specific vulnerabilities, and rarity of authentication events. Adjust detections based on findings.

config.description: Record hunt results when no confirmed threat is found.
